title: State funding for K-12, billions of dollars: 2025-27 adopted and 2027-29 estimates
description: Bar chart: the 2025-27 State School Fund, its 2027-29 current service level, and the Quality Education Commission's two 2027-29 estimates.

bars.label: Keep 2025-27 service levels
bars.group: Commission estimate, all core state funding

bars.label: Meet the state's goals
bars.group: Commission estimate, all core state funding

notes: The current service level is the Department of Administrative Services' estimate, as used in the Quality Education Commission's 2026 report [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.103].

The commission's two estimates count the State School Fund and other state money [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.103]. The commission leaves what counts as adequate to the Legislature [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.117].
